scope: Execution, saving, deadline and inference checks. These bounded model updates do not establish trained solver quality.

principles.Model the Domain: The wrapper owns the deadline and run setup; the original trainer owns model state and exports.
principles.Prove It Works: Real MPS updates, a 30-second real trainer deadline, saved export verification and 100 MLX predictions passed.
principles.Explain the Number: The 6-8 minute estimate is extrapolated from bounded runs; Sudoku solve count was independently rescored on exactly 2000 masked boards.
